More on Intellect Devourer from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Intellect Devourer", "Mythic Intellect Devourer", "Intellect Devourer" but are not part of the Intellect Devourer entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Intellect Devourer

INTELLECT DEVOURER
CR 7

This creature is the size of a dog, but with a head entirely made of exposed brain. It moves with astonishing grace despite having no discernible eyes. A glistening membrane or mucus covers its form.

CE Small aberration (evil, psionic)

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+1 size, +5 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 45 (6d8+18)
Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +6
DR 10/adamantine; Immune fire; Resist electricity 15; PR 23
Weaknesses vulnerability to protection from evil

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 4 claws +6 (1d3+1)
Special Attacks body thief
Psi-like Abilities (ML 7th)

At will—cloud mind, compression, detect psionics, ego whip (2d4, DC 16*), empty mind (+5 on Will saves*), id insinuation (three targets, DC 16*)
3/day—body adjustment (2d12*), intellect fortress, painful strike

The save DCs are Charisma-based.

*Includes augmentation for the intellect devourer’s manifester level.

ECOLOGY

Environment underground
Organization solitary or pod (2-4)
Treasure 1/2 coins; double goods; standard items

Intellect devourers have the ability to understand Common, but cannot speak unless they are in possession of a body that has the ability to speak. An intellect devourer in possession of a body knows all the languages that the victim knows.

Intellect devourers stalk their prey, relying on stealth and psionic powers to remain undetected and catch their victims unaware. It will use its psi-like abilities to overcome an enemy if it can catch them by surprise, then using its body thief ability to inhabit and control the corpse, pretending to be the victim while it seeks out new prey.

From d20pfsrd.com: Mythic Intellect Devourer

ABOUT

Environment any underground
Organization solitary, brood (1 mythic intellect devourer and 2–6 intellect devourers), or tribe (1 mythic intellect devourer and 7–17 intellect devourers)

Variants
Mythic Psionic Intellect Devourer

A mythic psionic intellect devourer has identical statistics in most respects, but gains the psionic subtype, its spell resistance becomes power resistance, and it gains Wild Talent as a bonus feat. In addition, it replaces a standard intellect devourer’s spell-like abilities with the following psi-like abilities:

Psi-Like Abilities (ML 8th; concentration +12)

Constant—detect psionics
At will— cloud mind (three creatures, DC 19), compression (two size categories), ego whip (2d4, DC 18*), empty mind (+5 on Will saves*), id insinuation (three targets, DC 18*)
3/day—body adjustment (3d12), intellect fortress (2 rounds), painful strike
